description: Use this after start_site_audit to check whether the audit has finished. Takes the audit_id. Returns status (queued, running, completed, failed or canceled), pages crawled so far, the page limit, and any notes or error text. If the status is failed, the error field says why (for example the site blocked the crawler or robots.txt disallows it). Also returns phase, a plain-English message with the stage, pages crawled and time left, progress_pct, stalled and next_check_after_s. After each call, show the user the message, then call again after next_check_after_s seconds (20 to 30) until the status is completed, failed or canceled. A big audit can take 20 to 60 minutes, so keep calling for as long as the status is running or queued. When completed it also returns report_url, pdf_url and csv_url.
name: get_audit_status
title: Check audit status
